description: This file defines a utility object 'SplitUtils' that provides a method to split a string into tokens based on spaces and stores the tokens in a linked list. It includes internal helper functions for validation and token processing.

classes.name: SplitUtils
classes.description: A utility object providing string splitting functionality.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a provided string into tokens based on spaces, returning a linked list of tokens.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the list if it is valid (not empty).

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks if a token is valid, currently ensuring it is not empty.
